fact: The Ministry of Health and Ghana Health Service, supported by WHO and UNDP, run a programme on AI, Digital Health and Human Security whose key focus is AI-enabled disease surveillance joining routine health data with climate data to predict malaria, cholera and meningitis.

GRA Deputy Commissioner Elsie Appau-Klu says the Ghana Revenue Authority is using AI and machine learning to identify anomalies in tax filings, expose suspicious trade activities and trigger targeted audits.
